descriptions.rgb: The camera looks downward over the wearer’s torso and two hands toward an orange-covered work surface directly in front of the body, all within about 0.2–0.6 m of the camera. A small round metal bowl sits near the far-center of the orange surface, roughly 0.4–0.6 m away, with a white fibrous object just to its right and stacked rectangular items partly visible along the left edge. The wearer’s hands remain within arm’s reach and move from being separated on the left and right to meeting near the center, repeatedly enclosing or rotating a small white object; the right hand shifts leftward while the left hand shifts slightly rightward across the five frames. Beyond the surface, an empty wooden chair faces approximately toward the camera from about 1–1.5 m ahead, positioned over or just beyond a circular multicolored floor design, while additional furniture and upright objects are partly cropped along the upper and side edges. No other person is clearly visible; the wearer’s torso occludes the lower scene, the orange surface occludes the floor immediately ahead, and the hands intermittently occlude the small white object and portions of the bowl.
